post.topic: Automated Customer Review Collection for Small Businesses
post.headline: Stop Missing Out on 5-Star Google Reviews
post.subline: Here is a simple 3-step automation tip to collect customer reviews effortlessly after every completed job.
post.caption:
Most small business owners forget to ask for reviews when a service is done.

Here’s a quick automation tip you can implement today:

1. Trigger an automated text or email 2 hours after a completed service or order.
2. Ask a simple 1-to-5 rating question first.
3. Automatically route happy customers straight to your Google Review link.

This single workflow converts satisfied clients into permanent social proof without adding any manual work to your daily schedule.
